manual_review.rationale: Ciccione and colleagues report a 4,5-difluorinated central ring in neutral compound 4e. The CIF lists C34H44F2N4Ni separately from methanol of crystallization; The crystal model includes both N1–H1 and N4–H4. The authors assign Ni(II) and two antiferromagnetically coupled peripheral diiminosemiquinone radicals. The reference localizes one radical each on N4 and N6 in the original XYZ numbering, N3 and N8 each carry −1. The total charge is zero. The CCDC registered name uses nickel(III). The electronic assignment follows the paper's analysis of neutral 4e
